scope: 50 states and DC for county analysis; source records for Puerto Rico and foreign origins are retained and flagged where published. Retrieved NOAA files contain all 50 states and DC with native county geography.
year_convention: IRS second filing year; ACS five-year period ending year; FEMA incident starting year; NOAA calendar year.

sources.publisher: Internal Revenue Service, Statistics of Income
sources.grain: County pair / migration filing-year interval / publication view, plus summary records
sources.access: Public HTTPS ZIP/XLS through 2011; CSV from 2012; no API key
fields: AGI in thousands of nominal dollars
limitations: Matched tax returns, not full population
Series breaks in 2012 and 2023 ending years
Suppressed cells and omitted pairs are not zeros
Inflow and outflow files are alternative publication views; do not sum them
Native geographic boundaries; no historical reallocation
Adjacent windows overlap four years
Selected employment and education table availability differs in early vintages; availability is reported per variable
Negative API special values become null with flags
Dollar estimates retain their published dollar-year basis
Derived percentages do not have propagated MOEs
Native county boundaries, including Connecticut planning regions

sources.grain: Current county / previous county or world region / five-year period
sources.access: 2009 fixed-width bulk file; 2010-2015 Census API by state; later county-to-county releases national API queries
limitations: Estimates of moves in the prior year pooled over five survey years, not five-year cumulative totals
Only total flows requested, not changing demographic cross-tabulations
Foreign origins are retained separately from domestic pairs
Not concatenated with newer state-origin flows or IRS flows

sources.grain: Origin state / destination county / five-year period
limitations: Cannot reconstruct county-pair flows
Within-state moves may include within-county mobility; not a county-to-county substitute

sources.access: Public bulk CSV from OpenFEMA; no key
limitations: Declarations do not measure all hazards or damage severity
County geography unavailable before 1964
Statewide/tribal/unmapped records preserved but excluded from county counts
Annual count is distinct disaster numbers by incident starting year
Missing incident dates are retained without assigning an incident year
Prior years can be revised

sources.dataset: nClimDiv county monthly temperature and precipitation
sources.access: Versioned fixed-width bulk files, no CDO token
limitations: Climate state codes must be mapped to FIPS; DC has the special NCDC county code 18511
County area averages, not resident-weighted exposure
Retrieved files contain all 50 states and DC; inspect native county boundaries and actual join coverage
Actual temperature files use -99.90 for missing months; the older readme lists -99.99; both are handled
Annual totals/means require 12 valid months
Annual temperatures are unweighted means of 12 monthly means
Recent years and older data can be revised

analysis_geography: Counties outside AK/CT; official Alaska and Connecticut state features and interstate migration totals, labeled geography_level=state.
cleaning_support_sources: IRS state CSVs 2019-2023 and county-file interstate state summaries 2009-2018
